title: Trump Privately Assured Netanyahu He Will Thwart Iran's Nuclear Program Amid Deal Jitters
detail: Trump privately assured Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu that he will thwart Iran's nuclear program, seeking to ease Israeli anxieties about the emerging US-Iran deal. The assurance underscores growing tension between the deal's momentum and Israel's demand for airtight security guarantees — Netanyahu has repeatedly warned that any deal allowing Iran to retain enrichment capacity is unacceptable to Israel. The private communication signals Washington is managing a dual-track approach: pursuing a negotiated settlement with Tehran while simultaneously reassuring its closest regional ally that Israel's core security interests will not be sacrificed. Israeli officials have expressed concern that US eagerness to close a deal could lead to concessions on enrichment that leave Iran only weeks from a nuclear breakout.

media.caption: Trump privately assured Netanyahu he will thwart Iran's nuclear program amid Israeli jitters over the emerging US-Iran deal
